svg.title: External DP over TCP vs InfiniBand RDMA and Wide TP
svg.desc: Six-panel line chart comparing Wide TP (NVLink), External DP over TCP and External DP over InfiniBand RDMA across concurrency 1 to 64 on 1024/256 and 4096/128 shapes for TTFT p50 (ms, log scale), ITL p99 (ms, log scale) and output throughput (tok/s). Over InfiniBand RDMA at concurrency 64, External DP exceeds Wide TP output on both shapes (3,921.562 vs 2,314.155 tok/s; 2,033.762 vs 1,491.536 tok/s) and lowers median TTFT by 16.13x and 10.44x, while Wide TP retains higher throughput at concurrencies 1 to 32 and lower ITL p99 in all 12 cells.
svg.text: MODEL DEPLOYMENT · EXTERNAL DP BENCHMARK · RDMA FOLLOW-UP
External DP over TCP vs InfiniBand RDMA and Wide TP
One 8 × H100 SXM5 node with 8 × ConnectX-7 InfiniBand adapters; DP = 4, TP = 2 per Pod, round_robin routing.
External DP over InfiniBand RDMA (4 Pods)
RDMA follow-up used NCCL GDRDMA on 8 × ConnectX-7 InfiniBand (1,088/1,088 requests, 0 errors); Wide TP was not rerun in this follow-up.
RDMA External DP led output at c=64; Wide TP led c=1–32 output and all ITL p99 cells. At 1024/256 c=8, RDMA ITL p99 rose vs TCP (64.911 vs 26.162 ms).
